subtopics.definition: User cannot log in despite entering correct credentials, or the app shows errors like 'something went wrong' during sign-in.
subtopics.name: Login failures

subtopics.definition: User is logged out of their account without action on their part and cannot easily log back in.
subtopics.name: Unexpected logouts

subtopics.definition: Problems specifically logging in or signing up using a mobile phone number, including OTP/verification code failures.
subtopics.name: Phone number login issues

subtopics.definition: Account was compromised by another user, or was suspended/banned/terminated by Spotify without clear reason.
subtopics.name: Account hacked, banned, or terminated

subtopics.definition: Issues resetting or changing password, including forced resets due to suspicious activity flags.
subtopics.name: Password reset problems

subtopics.definition: User lost playlists, liked songs, or account data as a result of a login or account access problem.
subtopics.name: Lost playlists or data after login issue

subtopics.definition: Difficulty creating a new account, including regional restrictions preventing signup.
subtopics.name: Account creation/signup problems

subtopics.definition: Complaints about too many ads, ads playing too often, or ad breaks being too long for free users.
subtopics.name: Excessive or frequent ads

subtopics.definition: Inability to turn off shuffle, shuffle getting stuck on, or songs playing in unwanted random order.
subtopics.name: Shuffle mode problems

subtopics.definition: Missing ability to skip, repeat, seek to a specific part of a song, or control playback precisely.
subtopics.name: Limited playback controls

subtopics.definition: Dislike of a new interface layout, navigation changes, or requests to revert to a previous design.
subtopics.name: UI/design change complaints

subtopics.definition: Problems managing, editing, viewing, or losing the play queue or playlists through the interface.
subtopics.name: Queue and playlist management issues

subtopics.definition: Inability to remove listening history or find the recently played section after it was moved or removed.
subtopics.name: History and recently played issues

subtopics.definition: Problems accessing or viewing the annual Spotify Wrapped feature.
subtopics.name: Wrapped feature issues

subtopics.definition: The app crashes, freezes, or becomes unresponsive and requires restarting.
subtopics.name: App crashes or freezes

subtopics.definition: Music or podcasts stop playing, pause themselves, or skip to a different track without user action.
subtopics.name: Songs stop, pause, or skip unexpectedly

subtopics.definition: Selecting one song or podcast results in a different one playing instead.
subtopics.name: Wrong track plays

subtopics.definition: App reports no internet connection or fails to connect despite a working network.
subtopics.name: False or persistent connection errors

subtopics.definition: Delays before playback starts, audio lag, or poor sound quality during streaming.
subtopics.name: Audio lag or quality issues

subtopics.definition: Problems with Spotify Connect, Bluetooth devices, Android Auto, or smart device integration during playback.
subtopics.name: Device, Bluetooth, and car integration issues

subtopics.definition: Playback stopped working correctly specifically after installing a recent app update.
subtopics.name: Playback broken after update

subtopics.definition: Downloaded songs or podcasts fail to play when the device is offline despite being marked as downloaded.
subtopics.name: Offline playback not working

subtopics.definition: Attempting to download tracks, albums, or playlists does not complete or produces errors.
subtopics.name: Songs fail to download

subtopics.definition: Previously downloaded songs or playlists vanish and must be re-downloaded.
subtopics.name: Downloaded content disappearing

subtopics.definition: Problems controlling storage location, automatic downloading on metered data, or managing download space.
subtopics.name: Download storage and settings issues

subtopics.definition: Specific problems downloading or playing podcast episodes offline.
subtopics.name: Offline podcast playback issues

subtopics.definition: Specific songs, albums, or artists are unavailable, removed, or restricted on Spotify.
subtopics.name: Missing or removed songs and artists

subtopics.definition: Lyrics fail to load, display incorrectly, or were removed as a feature.
subtopics.name: Lyrics not loading or removed

subtopics.definition: Searching for songs, artists, or podcasts returns no results or fails to work.
subtopics.name: Search function problems

subtopics.definition: Complaints about irrelevant, repetitive, or low-quality personalized recommendations, radio, or mix playlists.
subtopics.name: Poor recommendations or radio/mix quality

subtopics.definition: Lack of sufficient content in a specific regional language or genre.
subtopics.name: Regional or language content gaps

subtopics.definition: Previously free features such as skipping, repeating, or seeking within a song now require a Premium subscription.
subtopics.name: Basic features locked behind Premium

subtopics.definition: Payment attempts for Premium fail, get stuck pending, or money is charged without activating the subscription.
subtopics.name: Payment or subscription processing failure

subtopics.definition: User has paid for Premium but the app still shows ads, limits, or free-tier restrictions.
subtopics.name: Premium not recognized or not activating

subtopics.definition: Complaints that subscription price is too expensive or not worth the cost.
subtopics.name: Price or cost complaints

subtopics.definition: User reports still receiving ads, especially on podcasts, while subscribed to Premium.
subtopics.name: Ads despite paying for Premium

subtopics.definition: Complaints about limited number of song skips allowed per hour for non-premium users.
subtopics.name: Skip limit restrictions for free users

subtopics.definition: Customer support does not reply at all or takes an excessive amount of time to respond.
subtopics.name: Unresponsive or no customer support

subtopics.definition: Support is contacted but the reported problem is never actually fixed or resolved.
subtopics.name: Support fails to resolve issue

subtopics.definition: Support interactions described as rude, scripted, automated, or otherwise unhelpful in manner.
subtopics.name: Rude or low-quality support interactions

subtopics.definition: User struggles to find any way to contact a live support agent, being redirected to forums or self-service only.
subtopics.name: Difficult to reach support channel

subtopics.definition: Support does not help, or it is difficult, to cancel a subscription or delete an account.
subtopics.name: Difficulty canceling or deleting account
